story.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.5 Instant as new default ChatGPT model, targeting law, medicine, and finance
story.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-5.5 Instant as the new default model for ChatGPT, replacing its predecessor across the platform. The company says the model reduces hallucinations in high-stakes domains including law, medicine, and finance while preserving the low-latency speed users expect. The update affects all ChatGPT users by default, making it one of the most broadly impactful model rollouts OpenAI has executed.
